snippet.title: Idle Critter Adventure - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Ever wanted to play a monster but sometimes not play it and have it complete itself. Introducing Idle Critter Adventure! Main screen it, second screen it, go out and come back later as you travel the Dorma region capturing Critters and beating trainers to become the Champion.
Then gain some bonuses and loop back to do it again finding rarer Critters!

Buy it now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3457230?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=launch
